verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev exposes a Management/public API and SDK that let an agent trigger tasks, wait for results, check status, cancel/retry, and manage projects (docs-15/16/23/24/27/33), and deployment can be automated via CLI/GitHub Actions (docs-8). However, workflows ('tasks') are authored as code and deployed via CLI/CI rather than created or updated as objects through a public API endpoint — there's no evidence of an API call to programmatically define or activate a new task/workflow purely via the API. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints to create/update a task/workflow definition itself (not just trigger runs), and evidence of an agent doing full create+update+activate lifecycle without code deployment.
